title: Idaho Legislature passes bill for Medicaid expansion work requirements by 2027
author: Kyle Pfannenstiel
summary: The Idaho Legislature has passed House Bill 913, which mandates work requirements for adults enrolled in Medicaid expansion, potentially leading to the removal of up to 44% of participants, or approximately 34,000 individuals, by 2028. Proponents argue that the bill ensures that those who can work are doing so, while critics contend that it imposes unnecessary barriers that could disqualify working Idahoans from receiving essential health coverage. This legislation is significant as it could undermine the Medicaid expansion approved by voters in 2018, which aimed to assist the working poor in accessing healthcare.
